Thanks for the heads up, Priya — and great data in the CSV. Quick summary from our side after an initial pass:

1) Root cause note — we do see short-lived KV-cache thrash on the Dedicated pool during your peak window (approx 17:30–20:00 ET). That lines up with the tail latency you flagged. It's not model throttling; it's queue depth + suboptimal batching for that request mix.

2) Short-term mitigations (can implement within 48–72hrs):
   - Enable adaptive batching policy for Greenfields routes (reduces tail by ~30–40% in our tests).
   - Reserve an extra 0.5 GPU equivalent for the 90-minute evening window (auto-scale rule) to smooth queue spikes.

3) Renewal/commit options — we prepared three high-level scenarios (attached doc):
   - Option A (Conservative): +15% token commit, keep current SLA, add 20% burst credits.
   - Option B (Balanced): +25% commit, 10% introductory discount year 1, enable adaptive batching + prefix caching tuned by Redwood Optimize.
   - Option C (Aggressive): +40% commit, 15% discount, reserved extra evening capacity, and a quarterly performance review with guaranteed remediation SLAs.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_Greenfields_v2.docx (draft options + timeline). I also exported a short ROI table to show cost per 1M tokens under each scenario after expected batching/caching savings.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal sync (Redwood ops + account) tomorrow 11am PT to finalize numbers for procurement. Monica — can you bring the actual cost math (token -> $) for Options A/B/C and flag any margin constraints?
- Priya/Carlos — can we schedule a 30-minute renewal decision call on Friday (2 Sep) to go over the matrix and procurement asks? If that works, I’ll create a meeting invite and share a DocuSign amendment draft post-call.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher

Adding some numbers for the internal sync:

- Current run-rate tokens (billing): ~42.6M tokens/month (June baseline). May->Aug trend shows a daily increase that averages to +48% MoM for the pilot cohort — CSV confirms.
- Effective unit cost today: $11.8 per 1M tokens (hosted price buckets applied).
- Projected effective unit cost with batching/caching improvements: $8.9–$9.9 per 1M tokens (depending on hit rate).

Margin note: to keep gross margin ~60% on a reserved commit we can offer up to a 12% discount on a multi-quarter commit; deeper discounts require reserve capacity commitments (we can do up to 15% discount for a 12-month + reserved evening corridor).

Operational recommendation: go with Option B (Balanced) — +25% commit, 10% intro discount year 1, enable adaptive batching and a triage SLA for evening peaks. That keeps price sensible and buys headroom without overcommitting.
